event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approximately 3.56 nm off Tanjung Piai, (Malaysia), in the Singapore Strait (SS). Malaysia 01° 12.38' N

sources.title: Piracy monthly report May 2023
sources.text: While the tug boat towing barge was underway, the master of the tug boat reported to Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) West that three perpetrators boarded the barge and stole some scrap metal on board. The master sounded the alarm, and all crew was mustered and accounted for. The crew members were safe, and the master confirmed that no further assistance is required.
